gaps.what: What the schools actually spent, per line, in any year before FY2026
gaps.why: The district publishes a column headed ACTUAL in its forward budget books, and twelve years of it load as `budget_figure` where stage='restated' — the stage was called `actual` until 7 September 2026, and the rename is the point. Those are RESTATEMENTS — a prior year re-presented inside a document written by the party that spent it — and `document-basis.csv` classifies all sixteen source documents behind them as `restatement` (14) or `forward` (2). None is a ledger. The archive holds ten ledger documents in total, and the only ones reaching school general-fund spending are one quarter of FY23 and FY2026 period 12. So the question 'did the schools spend what they budgeted' cannot be settled before FY2026 from anything published: both sides of the comparison come out of the same budget book, and a restatement cannot show money moved between lines mid-year because approved transfers do not appear in a budget document. — closes: the MUNIS year-end expense report (glytdbud, period 13) for the school department for each year wanted, which is the same report we already hold for FY2026.

gaps.what: Why a budget line came in under plan, as against by how much
gaps.why: A line under plan can be a post left vacant, a service cut, a grant that covered the cost instead, money transferred to another line, or a line over-budgeted from the start. All five produce the same smaller number in the spent column. The accounting system narrows it — it records mid-year transfers, so money moved can be distinguished from money not spent, and we hold that for FY2026 — but it cannot separate a vacancy from a cancelled service from a funding switch. Every published explanation of a Lunenburg school surplus is therefore a hypothesis about a measurement, and this project must not restate one as the measurement. — closes: payroll detail by position and date for the year in question, which separates a vacancy from every other cause, plus the grant award records for the same year.
